item.title: DOJ asks Supreme Court to lift block on White House ballroom construction
item.description: The Justice Department petitioned the Supreme Court on Friday to remove a lower court's injunction halting construction of the new White House ballroom.

item.title: U.S. AI leadership requires strategic interdependence
item.description: China is accessing America's AI expertise. The solution is controlled, precise openness.

item.title: Democrats pass resolution seeking to abolish ICE
item.description: The latest Democratic action underscores the choice in the upcoming midterm elections between reason and extremism.

item.title: Data centers become political issue in 2026 races
item.description: Data centers have shifted from economic boons to political liabilities as public sentiment turns and former supporters scramble to adapt.
